label: minor
en: A car bumped our parked tricycle. Everyone is walking normally, nobody has pain or injury, and both vehicles are safely off the road.
tl: Nabangga ng kotse ang nakaparada naming traysikel. Normal maglakad ang lahat, walang sakit o sugat, at ligtas na nakatabi ang dalawang sasakyan.
ceb: Nabanggaan sa awto ang among nakaparadang traysikol. Normal ra molakaw ang tanan, walay sakit o samad, ug luwas nang nakatabi ang duha ka sakyanan.
mixed: Naigo ang parked tricycle sa car. Everyone walking normally, walay pain or injury ug safely off the road na ang vehicles.
rationale: Explicitly no injury or pain, normal function, and a safe current scene.

label: minor
en: A bicycle brushed a pedestrian's bag without touching the person. They feel well, have no injury, and continue walking safely without pain.
tl: Nasagi ng bisikleta ang bag pero hindi ang tao. Maayos ang pakiramdam, walang sugat, at ligtas siyang nakapagpatuloy nang walang sakit.
ceb: Nasangit sa bisikleta ang bag pero wala maigo ang tawo. Maayo ang pamati, walay samad, ug luwas nga nagpadayon nga walay sakit.
mixed: Bicycle brushed pedestrian's bag, wala natouch ang person. Feels well, walay injury or pain ug safely continuing to walk na siya.
rationale: Explicitly no bodily impact, injury, pain, or remaining exposure.

label: minor
en: The engine is dead, but nobody was hit or injured. The van is safely parked off the road with no smoke.
tl: Patay ang makina pero walang nabangga o nasaktan. Ligtas na nakaparada sa gilid ang van at walang usok.
ceb: Patay ang makina pero walay nabanggaan o nasamdan. Luwas nga nakaparada sa daplin ang van ug walay aso.
mixed: Dead ang engine, dili tawo. Nobody injured, naa na sa safe roadside ang van, walay smoke ug clear ang traffic.
rationale: Dead describes an engine, while the report explicitly rules out injury and an active road hazard.

label: minor
en: Two motorcycles touched mirrors at walking speed. Neither rider fell or suffered any injury, and both moved safely away from traffic.
tl: Nagkadikitan ang salamin ng dalawang mabagal na motorsiklo. Walang rider na natumba o nasaktan at ligtas na silang nakatabi mula sa trapiko.
ceb: Nagdikit ang samin sa duha ka hinay nga motor. Walay rider nga natumba o nasamdan ug luwas na silang nakatabi gikan sa trapiko.
mixed: Two slow motorcycles touched mirrors. Neither rider fell, walay injuries ug both moved safely away from traffic, clear na ang road.
rationale: Multiple involved people do not imply an injury when all are explicitly unhurt and the scene is safe.

label: serious
en: A car hit the back of a tricycle. One passenger is awake and breathing normally, but an injured leg cannot support weight.
tl: Nabangga ang likod ng traysikel. Gising at normal ang paghinga ng isang pasahero pero hindi makatayo dahil sa nasaktang binti.
ceb: Nabanggaan ang likod sa traysikol. Mata ug normal ang pagginhawa sa pasahero pero dili makatindog tungod sa nasamdan nga paa.
mixed: Rear collision sa tricycle. Awake ug normal breathing ang passenger pero dili makatindog kay injured ang leg ug kinahanglan og assistance.
rationale: Meaningful injury and loss of walking function, with explicitly preserved consciousness and breathing.

label: serious
en: A motorcycle struck a pedestrian. They are answering clearly and breathing normally, but their swollen ankle prevents them from walking.
tl: Nasagi ng motorsiklo ang isang tao. Malinaw siyang sumasagot at normal huminga pero namamaga ang bukungbukong at hindi siya makalakad.
ceb: Nadasmagan sa motor ang usa ka tawo. Klaro motubag ug normal moginhawa pero hubag ang buolbuol ug dili makalakaw.
mixed: Motorcycle hit a pedestrian. Alert ug normal breathing siya, pero swollen ang ankle ug dili makalakaw, need responder assistance.
rationale: Explicit injury needing timely help without stated immediate life-threatening signs.

label: serious
en: The stalled van blocks a blind curve at night. Nobody is hurt, but approaching vehicles keep swerving around it.
tl: Nakaharang ang tumirik na van sa kurbadang madilim. Walang nasaktan pero biglang umiiwas ang mga paparating na sasakyan.
ceb: Nagbara ang natirikan nga van sa ngitngit nga kurbada. Walay nasamdan pero kalit manglikay ang nagsingabot nga mga sakyanan.
mixed: Stalled van blocks a blind curve at night. Walay injured pero approaching vehicles keep swerving, kinahanglan og traffic assistance karon.
rationale: An ongoing road hazard needs urgent response despite no current casualty.

label: serious
en: Three riders fell after a collision. Two have scratches; one is alert with a visibly bent forearm and controlled bleeding.
tl: Tatlong rider ang natumba matapos magbanggaan. Gasgas lang ang dalawa; gising ang isa ngunit baluktot ang bisig at napigil ang pagdurugo.
ceb: Tulo ka riders ang natumba sa bangga. Garas ra ang duha; mata ang usa pero nabawog ang bukton ug nahunong ang pagdugo.
mixed: Three riders fell. Two have scratches, pero ang usa awake with bent forearm; controlled na ang bleeding ug normal ang breathing.
rationale: Use the most affected casualty; a clear limb injury outweighs other minor scratches.

label: critical
en: After the rear collision, the passenger will not wake when called or tapped and is only gasping beside the tricycle.
tl: Pagkatapos ng bangga, hindi magising ang pasahero kahit tawagin at tapikin. Habol lang ang kanyang hininga sa tabi ng traysikel.
ceb: Human sa bangga, dili mamata ang pasahero bisan tawagon ug tapikon. Naghingalo lang siya sa daplin sa traysikol karon.
mixed: After the collision, passenger won't wake bisan tawagon ug tapikon. Gasping ra siya beside the tricycle ug walay klarong tubag.
rationale: Current unresponsiveness with abnormal gasping is an explicit life-threatening signal.

label: critical
en: The pedestrian is awake but blood keeps pouring from the thigh despite firm pressure. Clothing is soaked and they are becoming faint.
tl: Gising ang nasagasaan pero tuloy ang pagbuhos ng dugo sa hita kahit diniinan. Basang-basa ang damit at nanghihina na siya.
ceb: Mata ang nadasmagan pero sige og buhos ang dugo sa paa bisan gipislit. Basa ang sinina ug nagkaluya na siya.
mixed: Awake ang pedestrian pero blood keeps pouring from the thigh bisan gi-pressure. Soaked ang clothes ug murag mahimatay na siya.
rationale: Ongoing uncontrolled heavy bleeding is life-threatening even while the person remains awake.

label: critical
en: The engine has stopped and the driver is trapped as flames enter the cabin. They are shouting that they cannot get out.
tl: Tumigil ang makina at nakakulong ang drayber habang pumapasok ang apoy sa loob. Sumisigaw siyang hindi siya makalabas.
ceb: Mihunong ang makina ug natanggong ang drayber samtang misulod ang kalayo sa sulod. Nagsinggit siya nga dili makagawas.
mixed: Engine stopped and driver trapped inside. Flames are entering the cabin, nagsinggit siya nga dili makagawas ug naa pa sa sulod.
rationale: An occupied burning vehicle with blocked escape presents immediate threat to life.

label: critical
en: Two riders have small scratches, but the third lies motionless and does not answer. A witness cannot see their chest moving.
tl: May maliliit na gasgas ang dalawang rider pero hindi kumikilos o sumasagot ang ikatlo. Walang makitang paggalaw ng dibdib ang saksi.
ceb: Gagmay ra ang garas sa duha ka riders pero dili molihok o motubag ang ikatulo. Wala makita nga lihok sa dughan.
mixed: Two riders have small scratches, pero the third dili molihok or motubag. Witness cannot see chest movement sa tawo karon.
rationale: The unresponsive casualty determines severity regardless of minor injuries to others.

label: needs_review
en: There was a bump behind the tricycle. I arrived later and cannot tell whether anyone was injured or has already left.
tl: May banggaan daw sa likod ng traysikel. Nahuli ako ng dating at hindi ko alam kung may nasaktan o nakaalis na.
ceb: Naay bangga kuno sa likod sa traysikol. Ulahi ko niabot ug wala ko kahibalo kon naay nasamdan o nakalakaw na.
mixed: Naay rear collision daw sa tricycle. Late ko niabot, unsure kung naay injured or nakauli na ang mga tawo didto.
rationale: An event is reported but current casualty status is missing.

label: needs_review
en: Someone said a pedestrian was hit, but I only saw an abandoned bicycle. I have no information about the person's condition.
tl: May nagsabing nasagi ang naglalakad pero iniwang bisikleta lang ang nakita ko. Wala akong impormasyon sa kalagayan ng tao.
ceb: Naay miingon nga naigo ang naglakaw pero gibiling bisikleta ra akong nakita. Wala koy impormasyon sa kahimtang sa tawo.
mixed: Naigo daw ang pedestrian, pero abandoned bicycle ra akong nakita. No information ko kung asa siya o unsa iyang condition.
rationale: Second-hand collision information without an observed casualty condition cannot establish a severity.

label: needs_review
en: The message only says dead near the vehicle. I cannot tell whether it means the engine or a person.
tl: Patay malapit sa sasakyan lang ang mensahe. Hindi ko matukoy kung makina ba o isang tao ang tinutukoy nito.
ceb: Patay duol sa sakyanan ra ang mensahe. Dili nako matino kon makina ba o usa ka tawo ang gipasabot.
mixed: Message says dead near the vehicle, mao ra. Unsure ko kung engine ba or person ang pasabot, wala pay klarong details.
rationale: The subject of a potentially alarming word is explicitly unresolved.

label: needs_review
en: Help, several motorcycles are down ahead of us. From here we cannot see any riders or assess their condition.
tl: Tulong, may ilang motorsiklong nakatumba sa unahan namin. Mula rito hindi makita ang mga rider o malaman ang kalagayan nila.
ceb: Tabang, naay pipila ka motor nga natumba sa unahan. Gikan diri dili makita ang riders o mahibaloan ang ilang kahimtang.
mixed: Help, several motorcycles down sa unahan namo. Dili makita ang riders from here, unknown pa ang ilang condition ug injuries.
rationale: Short report contains a scene but no assessable casualty or hazard details.

label: minor
en: A pan briefly caught fire, but it is fully extinguished. Everyone is outside, breathing normally, with no burns or other injuries.
tl: Sandaling nagliyab ang kawali pero tuluyang patay na ang apoy. Nasa labas ang lahat, normal huminga, at walang paso o ibang pinsala.
ceb: Mikalit og siga ang kalaha pero napalong na gyud. Naa sa gawas ang tanan, normal moginhawa, ug walay paso o samad.
mixed: Pan caught fire briefly pero fully extinguished na. Everyone outside, normal breathing, walay burns or injuries ug walay remaining smoke.
rationale: A resolved fire with explicitly unaffected occupants does not imply current life threat.

label: minor
en: An unplugged extension cord has a small scorch mark. Power is isolated, nothing is burning, and nobody touched it or got hurt.
tl: May maliit na sunog na marka ang nakabunot na extension cord. Putol na ang kuryente, walang nasusunog, at walang nadikit o nasaktan.
ceb: Naay gamay nga paso ang natangtang nga extension cord. Naputol na ang kuryente, walay nagdilaab, ug walay nakahikap o nasamdan.
mixed: Unplugged extension cord has small scorch mark. Power isolated na, nothing burning, walay nakahikap ug nobody injured sa lugar.
rationale: The electrical source is explicitly isolated with no exposure, injury, or active fire.

label: minor
en: A little pile of dry leaves burned earlier. It is now cold and wet, far from buildings, and nobody was injured.
tl: Nasunog kanina ang maliit na bunton ng tuyong dahon. Malamig at basa na ito ngayon, malayo sa bahay, at walang nasaktan.
ceb: Nasunog ganina ang gamayng pundok sa uga nga dahon. Bugnaw ug basa na karon, layo sa balay, ug walay nasamdan.
mixed: Small leaf pile burned earlier. Cold and wet na karon, far from buildings, walay smoke ug nobody injured sa area.
rationale: Past fire is explicitly extinguished and presents no described remaining threat.

label: minor
en: Toast made smoke in the kitchen earlier. The smoke has cleared; everyone feels well, with no cough, burns, or breathing problem.
tl: Umakyat ang usok mula sa tinapay kanina. Maaliwalas na ngayon; maayos ang lahat at walang ubo, paso, o hirap sa paghinga.
ceb: Miaso ang tinapay sa kusina ganina. Tin-aw na karon; maayo ang tanan ug walay ubo, paso, o kalisod sa pagginhawa.
mixed: Toast made smoke earlier pero clear na ang kitchen. Everyone feels well, walay cough, burns or breathing problem karon.
rationale: Smoke exposure wording is accompanied by explicit resolution and absence of symptoms.

label: serious
en: The kitchen curtains are still burning. Everyone has evacuated without injury, but flames are spreading toward the wooden ceiling.
tl: Nasusunog pa ang kurtina sa kusina. Nakalabas na ang lahat nang walang pinsala pero kumakalat ang apoy patungo sa kisameng kahoy.
ceb: Nagdilaab pa ang kurtina sa kusina. Nakagawas na ang tanan nga walay samad pero mikatag ang kalayo paingon sa kahoyng kisame.
mixed: Kitchen curtains still burning. Everyone evacuated ug walay injured, pero flames spreading toward wooden ceiling, need fire response karon.
rationale: Ongoing spreading fire requires urgent response even with everyone accounted for outside.

label: serious
en: Sparks and smoke keep coming from the wall socket. Everyone is away from it, but the supply has not been disconnected.
tl: Patuloy ang kislap at usok mula sa saksakan. Lumayo na ang lahat pero hindi pa napuputol ang suplay ng kuryente.
ceb: Sige og kidlap ug aso ang saksakanan. Milayo na ang tanan pero wala pa maputol ang suplay sa kuryente karon.
mixed: Wall socket keeps sparking and smoking. Everyone stepped away, walay injured pero power supply still connected ug active pa ang hazard.
rationale: Persistent energized electrical fire hazard without a stated immediate casualty.

label: serious
en: Grass fire is moving toward empty sheds beside the road. Nobody is trapped or injured, but residents cannot stop its spread.
tl: Papalapit ang sunog sa damuhan sa mga bakanteng kubo. Walang nakakulong o nasaktan pero hindi mapigil ng mga residente ang pagkalat.
ceb: Nagpadulong ang sunog sa sagbot sa bakanteng mga payag. Walay natanggong o nasamdan pero dili mapugngan sa mga residente ang pagkatag.
mixed: Grass fire moving toward empty sheds. Walay trapped or injured pero residents cannot stop it, nag-spread gihapon toward nearby structures.
rationale: An uncontrolled spreading environmental fire is an urgent operational hazard.

label: serious
en: After escaping kitchen smoke, one adult remains awake and talks normally but has a painful blistered palm. Others are unhurt.
tl: Pagkalabas sa mausok na kusina, gising at normal magsalita ang isang adulto pero may masakit na paltos sa palad. Ligtas ang iba.
ceb: Human makagawas sa aso, mata ug normal mosulti ang usa ka hamtong pero sakit ug napaltos ang palad. Walay samad ang uban.
mixed: Everyone escaped kitchen smoke. One adult awake and talking normally pero painful blistered palm, unhurt ang uban ug clear na ang exit.
rationale: A described painful blistered burn warrants timely assessment without a stated life-threatening sign.

label: critical
en: A child is still inside the burning kitchen and the doorway is covered by flames. They are calling for help and cannot escape.
tl: Nasa nasusunog na kusina pa ang isang bata at natatakpan ng apoy ang pinto. Humihingi siya ng tulong at hindi makalabas.
ceb: Naa pa ang bata sulod sa nagdilaab nga kusina ug gitabonan sa kalayo ang pultahan. Nangayo siyag tabang ug dili makagawas.
mixed: Child still inside burning kitchen. Flames cover the doorway, nangayo siya og help ug dili makagawas bisan naningkamot na siya.
rationale: A person trapped by active flames is under an immediate life threat.

label: critical
en: After touching the burning electrical panel, the worker collapsed. They do not respond to shouting and appear not to be breathing.
tl: Bumagsak ang manggagawa matapos dumikit sa nasusunog na electrical panel. Hindi siya tumutugon sa sigaw at mukhang hindi humihinga.
ceb: Natumba ang trabahante human mohikap sa nagdilaab nga electrical panel. Dili siya motubag sa singgit ug murag dili moginhawa karon.
mixed: Worker collapsed after touching burning electrical panel. Dili siya morespond sa shouting ug appears not breathing, naa gihapon sa salog.
rationale: Unresponsiveness and absent apparent breathing following electrical exposure require highest urgency.

label: critical
en: Fast flames have surrounded two people in the field. Their escape path is burning and they are unable to cross out.
tl: Napapalibutan na ng mabilis na apoy ang dalawang tao sa bukid. Nasusunog ang daan palabas at hindi sila makatawid.
ceb: Gipalibotan na sa paspas nga kalayo ang duha ka tawo sa uma. Nagdilaab ang agianan pagawas ug dili sila makatabok.
mixed: Fast flames surround two people sa field. Burning na ang escape path ug dili sila makatabok, trapped pa silang duha karon.
rationale: Multiple people surrounded by current flames with no escape are in immediate danger.

label: critical
en: Most occupants escaped with no injuries, but one adult outside is barely breathing and will not wake after heavy smoke exposure.
tl: Nakalabas nang walang sugat ang karamihan pero halos hindi humihinga ang isang adulto sa labas at hindi magising matapos malanghap ang usok.
ceb: Nakagawas nga walay samad ang kadaghanan pero halos dili moginhawa ang usa ka hamtong ug dili mamata human masimhot ang daghang aso.
mixed: Most occupants okay outside, pero one adult barely breathing ug dili mamata after heavy smoke exposure, walay response sa pagtawag.
rationale: Severe breathing compromise and unresponsiveness dominate reassuring information about other occupants.

label: needs_review
en: I heard someone shout fire near a kitchen. I cannot see flames, smoke, people, or whether anything is happening now.
tl: May narinig akong sumigaw ng sunog malapit sa kusina. Hindi ko makita ang apoy, usok, mga tao, o kasalukuyang nangyayari.
ceb: Nakadungog ko og singgit nga sunog duol sa kusina. Dili nako makita ang kalayo, aso, mga tawo, o kon naay nahitabo karon.
mixed: Someone shouted fire near the kitchen. Dili ko makita ang flames, smoke or people, unsure if ongoing pa ang incident.
rationale: An unconfirmed warning without observable current conditions needs clarification.

label: needs_review
en: There is a burnt smell near the socket, but I am outside and cannot see whether it is smoking or already disconnected.
tl: May amoy sunog daw malapit sa saksakan pero nasa labas ako. Hindi ko makita kung umuusok pa o nakapatay na ang kuryente.
ceb: Naay baho nga sunog duol sa saksakanan pero naa ko sa gawas. Dili nako makita kon nag-aso pa o naputol na ang kuryente.
mixed: Burnt smell near socket daw, pero outside ko. Unknown kung smoking pa, disconnected na ang power, or naay nasamdan sulod.
rationale: Potential electrical warning lacks confirmation of an active hazard or occupant condition.

label: needs_review
en: Smoke is visible beyond the hill, but we cannot identify its source or see whether houses or people are nearby.
tl: May usok sa likod ng burol pero hindi matukoy ang pinagmulan. Hindi rin makita kung may mga bahay o tao roon.
ceb: Naay aso sa likod sa bungtod pero dili matino ang gigikanan. Dili usab makita kon adunay mga balay o tawo didto.
mixed: Visible smoke beyond the hill, pero unknown source. Dili makita kung naay houses or people nearby, wala pay confirmed fire details.
rationale: Distant smoke without known source, extent, or exposure cannot establish severity.

label: needs_review
en: The forwarded note says someone could stop breathing if smoke increases. It does not describe anyone's current symptoms or location in the building.
tl: Sabi sa ipinasa na mensahe, baka hindi makahinga kung lumakas ang usok. Walang nakasaad na kasalukuyang sintomas o kinaroroonan ng sinuman.
ceb: Ang gipasa nga mensahe nag-ingon nga basin dili kaginhawa kon modaghan ang aso. Walay kasamtangang sintomas o nahimutangan sa tawo nga gisulti.
mixed: Forwarded note says someone could stop breathing if smoke increases. Wala giingon nga actual na kini, unknown ang current symptoms sa people.
rationale: A hypothetical future breathing risk is not an observed present respiratory emergency.

label: minor
en: Rainwater briefly covered the yard but has fully drained. Everyone is dry indoors, no one was hurt, and the street is clear.
tl: Sandaling nabaha ang bakuran pero lubos nang humupa. Tuyo at ligtas ang lahat sa loob, walang nasaktan, at malinaw na ang kalsada.
ceb: Kadyot nga nabahaan ang nataran pero mihubas na gyud. Uga ug luwas ang tanan sulod, walay nasamdan, ug hawan na ang dalan.
mixed: Rainwater covered the yard earlier pero fully drained na. Everyone dry and safe indoors, nobody hurt ug clear na ang street.
rationale: Resolved shallow flooding with explicit safe occupants and access.

label: minor
en: A small amount of loose soil fell into an empty drainage ditch. The slope has stopped moving and no road or person was affected.
tl: Kaunting lupa ang nahulog sa bakanteng kanal. Huminto na ang paggalaw ng dalisdis at walang taong nasaktan o kalsadang naapektuhan.
ceb: Gamay nga yuta ang nahulog sa bakanteng kanal. Mihunong na ang lihok sa bakilid ug walay tawo o dalan nga naapektuhan.
mixed: Small loose soil fell into empty drainage ditch. Slope stopped moving na, walay person affected ug open gihapon ang road.
rationale: Explicitly limited, stopped soil movement without exposure or access obstruction.

label: minor
en: The family reached dry shelter before water rose. Everyone is accounted for, walking comfortably, and has no injury or remaining rescue need.
tl: Nakarating ang pamilya sa tuyong silungan bago tumaas ang tubig. Kumpleto sila, maayos maglakad, at walang sugat o kailangang iligtas ngayon.
ceb: Nakaabot ang pamilya sa uga nga kapasilongan sa wala pa mosaka ang tubig. Kompleto sila, maayo molakaw, walay samad ug walay natanggong.
mixed: Family reached dry shelter before water rose. Everyone accounted for, walking comfortably, walay injured ug no remaining rescue need karon.
rationale: Evacuation is complete and all people are explicitly safe with no active rescue need.

label: minor
en: During cleanup a glove brushed a blunt tool without breaking the skin. Everyone is uninjured, the flood has drained, and the area is safe.
tl: Nasagi ng guwantes ang mapurol na kagamitan habang naglilinis pero walang sugat. Walang nasaktan, humupa na ang baha, at ligtas na ang lugar.
ceb: Nasangit ang gwantes sa habol nga gamit sa paglimpyo pero walay samad. Walay nasamdan, mihubas na ang baha, ug luwas na ang lugar.
mixed: Glove brushed blunt cleanup tool, no broken skin. Everyone uninjured, flood fully drained na ug safe na ang entire cleanup area.
rationale: Explicit no-injury contact after flooding, with no ongoing water or scene hazard.

label: serious
en: Water is steadily entering several homes. All residents remain on dry raised floors, but their exit route is beginning to flood.
tl: Patuloy ang pagpasok ng tubig sa ilang bahay. Nasa tuyong mataas na sahig ang mga residente pero nagsisimula nang bahain ang daan palabas.
ceb: Padayon ang pagsulod sa tubig sa pipila ka balay. Naa sa uga nga taas nga salog ang mga residente pero nagsugod na pagbaha ang agianan pagawas.
mixed: Water steadily entering homes. Residents still on dry raised floors, pero exit route beginning to flood ug kinahanglan og evacuation assistance.
rationale: Ongoing rising flood threatens access and requires urgent assistance without a current drowning casualty.

label: serious
en: A landslide is blocking the only road, and loose rocks keep falling. Nobody is buried, but vehicles are approaching the blocked bend.
tl: Naharangan ng pagguho ang tanging kalsada at patuloy ang pagbagsak ng bato. Walang nabaon pero may mga sasakyang papalapit sa kurbada.
ceb: Gibabagan sa landslide ang bugtong dalan ug sige og kahulog ang bato. Walay nalubong pero adunay sakyanan nga nagpadulong sa kurbada.
mixed: Landslide blocks the only road, rocks still falling. Walay buried person pero vehicles approaching the bend, urgent road closure needed.
rationale: Active falling material and an obstructed road constitute an urgent ongoing hazard.

label: serious
en: Two adults are waiting on a dry upstairs landing with rising water below. They are awake and uninjured but cannot safely leave.
tl: Dalawang adulto ang naghihintay sa tuyong itaas na palapag habang tumataas ang tubig sa ibaba. Gising at walang sugat pero hindi makaalis nang ligtas.
ceb: Duha ka hamtong ang naghulat sa uga nga taas nga andana samtang mosaka ang tubig sa ubos. Mata ug walay samad pero dili makagawas luwas.
mixed: Two adults on dry upstairs landing, rising water below. Awake ug uninjured sila pero cannot safely leave, need assisted evacuation.
rationale: People need urgent evacuation while currently in a dry position without stated immediate life-threatening exposure.

label: serious
en: A cleanup worker slipped in mud and now cannot stand on a swollen knee. They are alert, breathing normally, and have no heavy bleeding.
tl: Nadulas sa putik ang tagalinis at hindi makatayo dahil sa namamagang tuhod. Gising siya, normal huminga, at walang malakas na pagdurugo.
ceb: Nadulas sa lapok ang naglimpyo ug dili makatindog tungod sa hubag nga tuhod. Mata siya, normal moginhawa, ug walay kusog nga pagdugo.
mixed: Cleanup worker slipped in mud, cannot stand on swollen knee. Alert ug normal breathing siya, walay heavy bleeding pero need assistance.
rationale: Functional injury requires urgent assessment, with no reported immediate life-threatening sign.

label: critical
en: Fast water swept a child off the steps. The child is struggling to keep their mouth above water and cannot reach anything solid.
tl: Tinangay ng mabilis na tubig ang bata mula sa hagdan. Hirap niyang iangat ang bibig sa tubig at walang makapitan.
ceb: Gianod sa kusog nga tubig ang bata gikan sa hagdan. Naglisod siyag pabilin sa baba ibabaw sa tubig ug walay makuptan.
mixed: Fast water swept child from steps. Struggling siya to keep mouth above water ug walay solid nga makuptan, naa pa sa agos.
rationale: Current struggle in moving water is an immediate drowning threat.

label: critical
en: A person is buried to the chest under fresh mud and rocks. They are struggling to breathe while more soil keeps sliding down.
tl: Nabaon hanggang dibdib ang tao sa bagong putik at bato. Nahihirapan siyang huminga habang patuloy na dumudulas pababa ang lupa.
ceb: Nalubong hangtod dughan ang tawo sa bag-ong lapok ug bato. Naglisod siyag ginhawa samtang padayon nga nangalusot ang yuta.
mixed: Person buried to chest under fresh mud and rocks. Struggling to breathe siya ug more soil keeps sliding down sa iyaha.
rationale: Entrapment with current breathing compromise and ongoing burial is immediately life-threatening.

label: critical
en: After being pulled from the flood, one adult does not respond and has no visible chest movement. Others reached shore safely.
tl: Pagkaahon sa baha, hindi tumutugon ang isang adulto at walang makitang paggalaw ng dibdib. Ligtas na nakarating sa pampang ang iba.
ceb: Human mahakot gikan sa baha, dili motubag ang usa ka hamtong ug walay makita nga lihok sa dughan. Luwas na ang uban sa pangpang.
mixed: Pulled one adult from flood, dili siya morespond ug no visible chest movement. Others safe on shore, pero this person motionless.
rationale: An unresponsive flood casualty with no apparent breathing determines severity despite other successful rescues.

label: critical
en: During cleanup a broken sheet cut a worker's leg. Blood is spurting and will not stop with pressure; they are becoming confused.
tl: Nahiwa ng sirang yero ang binti ng tagalinis. Bumubulwak ang dugo kahit diniinan at nagsisimula na siyang malito habang kausap.
ceb: Nahiwa sa guba nga sin ang paa sa naglimpyo. Nagbuswak ang dugo bisan gipislit ug nagsugod na siyag kalibog samtang gitawag.
mixed: Broken sheet cut cleanup worker's leg. Blood spurting bisan pressure applied, dili mohunong ug becoming confused na ang worker karon.
rationale: Uncontrolled spurting bleeding with altered responsiveness is life-threatening regardless of incident category.

label: needs_review
en: The report only says water is everywhere near the houses. It gives no depth, movement, injury, or information about residents.
tl: Tubig sa buong paligid ng bahay lang ang ulat. Walang lalim, galaw ng tubig, pinsala, o impormasyon tungkol sa mga residente.

mixed: Report says water everywhere near houses, mao ra. No depth or flow details, unknown ang injuries ug status sa residents.
rationale: The report lacks information needed to distinguish nuisance water from dangerous flood exposure.

label: needs_review
en: A message says landslide beyond the bend. We cannot see the slope or know whether anybody is underneath or the road remains open.
tl: May mensaheng pagguho sa likod ng kurbada. Hindi makita ang dalisdis o malaman kung may nabaon at kung bukas pa ang daan.

mixed: Message says landslide beyond the bend. Can't see slope, unknown kung naay buried or road blocked, wala pay direct witness details.
rationale: Unverified landslide report has unknown exposure, activity, and access.

label: needs_review
en: Someone forwarded a request to rescue a family, but the sender cannot confirm whether they already evacuated or are still there.
tl: May ipinasa na hiling na iligtas ang pamilya pero hindi matiyak ng nagpadala kung nakaalis na sila o nandoon pa.
ceb: Naay gipasa nga hangyo nga luwason ang pamilya pero dili matino sa nagpadala kon nakabalhin na sila o naa pa didto.
mixed: Forwarded request to rescue family, pero sender unsure if evacuated na or naa pa didto. No current location or condition update.
rationale: Potentially stale rescue request lacks current exposure or casualty status.

label: needs_review
en: Help near the muddy cleanup area, someone is down. I cannot tell if they slipped, are resting, or are responding.
tl: Tulong sa maputik na lugar ng paglilinis, may nakahiga. Hindi ko matukoy kung nadulas, nagpapahinga, o tumutugon siya sa tawag.
ceb: Tabang duol sa lapukong limpiyohanan, naay naghigda. Dili nako matino kon nadulas, nagpahulay, o motubag ba siya sa tawag.
mixed: Help near muddy cleanup area, someone down. Unsure ko kung slipped, resting lang, or responding ba, dili ko klarong makita.
rationale: Unclear posture and unknown responsiveness cannot be converted into an asserted casualty state.

label: minor
en: An adult felt briefly dizzy after standing quickly. They sat down, fully recovered, stayed awake throughout, and now walk without symptoms.
tl: Sandaling nahilo ang adulto matapos biglang tumayo. Umupo at lubos nang bumuti, hindi nawalan ng malay, at nakakalakad nang walang sintomas.
ceb: Kadyot nga nalipong ang hamtong human kalit mitindog. Milingkod ug naulian na, wala nakuyapan, ug makalakaw na nga walay sintomas.
mixed: Adult briefly dizzy after standing quickly. Fully recovered after sitting, awake throughout, walay fainting ug walking normally na without symptoms.
rationale: Brief resolved dizziness with no loss of consciousness and explicitly normal current function.

label: minor
en: An adult worried a paper edge cut their finger, but the skin is intact. There is no wound, pain, bleeding, or movement problem.
tl: Nag-alalang nahiwa ng papel ang daliri pero buo ang balat. Walang sugat, sakit, pagdurugo, o problema sa paggalaw ng daliri niya ngayon.
ceb: Nabalaka nga nahiwa sa papel ang tudlo pero buo ang panit. Walay samad, sakit, pagdugo, o problema sa lihok sa tudlo karon.
mixed: Adult worried paper cut finger pero intact ang skin. No wound, pain or bleeding, normal ang finger movement ug feels well siya.
rationale: A feared cut is explicitly disproved by intact skin and no injury or symptoms.

label: minor
en: An adult sneezed after dust exposure but now feels completely well. They speak normally and have no chest pain or trouble breathing.
tl: Napabahing ang adulto dahil sa alikabok pero maayos na ngayon. Normal magsalita at walang sakit sa dibdib o hirap sa paghinga.
ceb: Mibahing ang hamtong tungod sa abog pero maayo na karon. Normal mosulti ug walay sakit sa dughan o kalisod sa pagginhawa.
mixed: Adult sneezed after dust exposure pero completely well na. Speaks normally, walay chest pain ug no trouble breathing karon.
rationale: Resolved limited irritation with explicit negation of chest and breathing symptoms.

label: minor
en: A runner had a brief calf cramp after exercise. It has fully stopped, with no collapse, shaking, injury, or difficulty walking now.
tl: Sandaling namulikat ang binti ng mananakbo pagkatapos mag-ehersisyo. Wala na ngayon, walang pagbagsak, panginginig, pinsala, o hirap sa paglakad.
ceb: Kadyot nga gipulikat ang paa sa nidagan human ehersisyo. Wala na karon, walay pagkahugno, pagkurog, samad, o kalisod sa paglakaw.
mixed: Runner had brief calf cramp after exercise, fully stopped na. No collapse or shaking, walay injury ug walking normally na karon.
rationale: Resolved localized muscle cramp explicitly distinguished from collapse or ongoing convulsions.

label: serious
en: An adult fainted a few minutes ago and is now awake and breathing normally. They remain weak and cannot stand without assistance.
tl: Nahimatay ang adulto ilang minuto na ang nakaraan at gising na ngayon, normal huminga. Mahina pa at hindi makatayo nang walang alalay.
ceb: Nakuyapan ang hamtong pila ka minuto ang milabay ug mata na karon, normal moginhawa. Luya pa ug dili makatindog kon walay alalay.
mixed: Adult fainted minutes ago, awake and normal breathing na. Still weak ug dili makatindog without assistance, kinahanglan og medical assessment.
rationale: Recovered consciousness does not erase a recent collapse with persistent functional impairment.

label: serious
en: A broken cup caused a deep forearm cut. Bleeding is controlled with pressure, and the person is alert but cannot move two fingers.
tl: Malalim ang hiwa sa bisig mula sa basag na tasa. Napigil ang dugo sa pagdiin at gising siya pero hindi maigalaw ang dalawang daliri.
ceb: Lalom ang hiwa sa bukton gikan sa nabuak nga tasa. Napugngan ang dugo sa pagpislit ug mata siya pero dili malihok ang duha ka tudlo.
mixed: Broken cup caused deep forearm cut. Controlled ang bleeding with pressure, alert siya pero cannot move two fingers sa injured hand.
rationale: Deep injury with lost finger function needs urgent assessment despite controlled bleeding.

label: serious
en: An adult has persistent fever and repeated vomiting. They are awake, speaking clearly, and breathing normally but cannot keep fluids down.
tl: May tuloy-tuloy na lagnat at pagsusuka ang adulto. Gising, malinaw magsalita, at normal huminga pero hindi mapanatili ang iniinom na tubig.
ceb: Padayon ang hilanat ug balik-balik nga pagsuka sa hamtong. Mata, klaro mosulti, ug normal moginhawa pero dili mapabilin ang giinom nga tubig.
mixed: Adult has persistent fever and repeated vomiting. Awake, clear speech ug normal breathing, pero cannot keep fluids down, need medical help.
rationale: Persistent symptoms and inability to retain fluids require prompt help without described immediate life-threatening signs.

label: serious
en: A brief shaking episode has stopped. The adult is now fully awake and breathing normally but has a painful shoulder injury from falling.
tl: Huminto na ang maikling panginginig. Lubos nang gising at normal huminga ang adulto pero masakit ang balikat na nasaktan sa pagkahulog.
ceb: Mihunong na ang kadyot nga pagkurog. Mata na gyud ug normal moginhawa ang hamtong pero sakit ang abaga nga nasamdan sa pagkahulog.
mixed: Brief shaking episode stopped. Adult fully awake ug normal breathing now, pero painful shoulder injury from fall, dili mausab og tarong ang bukton.
rationale: Recent concerning episode plus an ongoing injury warrants urgent assessment; current normal breathing does not imply fully resolved harm.

label: critical
en: The adult collapsed and has not woken up. They do not respond when their name is called and are taking irregular gasping breaths.
tl: Bumagsak ang adulto at hindi pa nagigising. Hindi tumutugon kapag tinatawag ang pangalan at putol-putol na hingal lang ang paghinga.
ceb: Nahugno ang hamtong ug wala pa mamata. Dili motubag kon tawagon ang ngalan ug putol-putol nga hingalo lang ang pagginhawa karon.
mixed: Adult collapsed and has not woken up. No response sa pagtawag sa name ug irregular gasping breaths lang ang makita namo.
rationale: Current unresponsiveness and gasping are explicit emergency signals.

label: critical
en: Blood is pumping from a deep arm wound and soaking every cloth despite pressure. The person is pale and no longer answers properly.
tl: Bumubulwak ang dugo sa malalim na sugat sa braso at nababasa ang bawat tela kahit diniinan. Maputla at hindi na maayos sumagot ang tao.
ceb: Nagbuswak ang dugo sa lalom nga samad sa bukton ug mabasa ang tanang panapton bisan gipislit. Luspad ug dili na tarong motubag ang tawo.
mixed: Blood pumping from deep arm wound, soaking cloths bisan pressure. Pale na ang person ug dili na makatubag properly sa questions.
rationale: Uncontrolled heavy bleeding with deteriorating responsiveness is life-threatening.

label: critical
en: An adult is clutching their chest and struggling for air. They cannot finish a sentence, and their lips are turning blue now.
tl: Hawak ng adulto ang dibdib at hirap humigop ng hangin. Hindi matapos ang pangungusap at nagiging asul na ang kanyang mga labi.
ceb: Gigunitan sa hamtong ang dughan ug naglisod sa pagginhawa. Dili mahuman ang usa ka sentence ug nagkaasul na ang iyang mga ngabil.
mixed: Adult clutching chest and struggling for air. Cannot finish a sentence, nag-blue na ang lips karon ug naglisod gyud siyag ginhawa.
rationale: Marked current respiratory compromise and cyanosis indicate immediate life threat.

label: critical
en: The person has been convulsing continuously for several minutes and does not respond. They are now turning blue around the mouth.
tl: Ilang minuto nang tuluy-tuloy ang pangingisay ng tao at hindi siya tumutugon. Nagiging asul na ngayon ang paligid ng kanyang bibig.
ceb: Pila na ka minuto ang padayon nga pagkisay sa tawo ug dili siya motubag. Nagkaasul na karon ang palibot sa iyang baba.
mixed: Person convulsing continuously for several minutes, dili morespond. Turning blue around the mouth na siya karon ug padayon gihapon ang pagkisay.
rationale: Ongoing convulsions with unresponsiveness and compromised oxygenation are immediately life-threatening.

label: needs_review
en: The note says an adult felt faint earlier. We do not know if they actually collapsed, recovered, or still have symptoms.

mixed: Note says adult felt faint earlier. Unknown if actually collapsed, recovered na, or still symptomatic, wala pay direct observation sa current condition.
rationale: Current state and whether loss of consciousness occurred are both unknown.

label: needs_review
en: Someone needs help for a wound, but the message has no body part, bleeding amount, depth, or information about how they feel.

ceb: Naay nangayo og tabang alang sa samad pero walay bahin sa lawas, kadaghan sa dugo, giladmon, o kahimtang sa tawo sa mensahe.
mixed: Someone needs help for wound, mao ra. No body part, depth or bleeding amount, unknown pud ang current feeling ug function niya.

label: needs_review
en: The patient said the medicine leaflet mentions trouble breathing. They have not said whether they currently have that symptom or any other complaint.

mixed: Patient says medicine leaflet mentions trouble breathing. Wala gi-confirm if actual symptom niya karon, unknown ang current complaint ug condition.
rationale: Quoted warning language is not evidence that the symptom is occurring.

label: needs_review
en: Help, the person is shaking, but the caller cannot explain whether they are cold, having cramps, responding, or breathing normally.

ceb: Tabang, nagkurog ang tawo pero dili masaysay sa nanawag kon gitugnaw, gipulikat, motubag ba, o normal ba ang pagginhawa niya.
mixed: Help, person shaking pero caller unsure if cold or cramps. Unknown kung responding ba siya ug normal ba ang breathing karon.
rationale: Shaking with no reliable current responsiveness or breathing description requires clarification.

label: minor
en: Two neighbors argued loudly earlier but have separated peacefully. Nobody was touched, injured, threatened, or carrying a weapon, and the area is calm.
tl: Nagtalo nang malakas ang magkapitbahay kanina pero mapayapa nang naghiwalay. Walang sinaktan, nasugatan, tinakot, o may sandata, at tahimik na ngayon.
ceb: Naglantugi og kusog ang silingan ganina pero malinawon nang nagbulag. Walay gipasakitan, nasamdan, gihulga, o nagdala og armas, ug kalma na karon.
mixed: Neighbors argued earlier pero peacefully separated na. Nobody touched or injured, no threats or weapons ug calm na ang area karon.

label: minor
en: There was one brief shove, but nobody fell or was injured. Both people left separately and peacefully, with no threats or ongoing conflict.

label: minor
en: A reported knife was actually a plastic toy. The misunderstanding is resolved, everyone is calm, and nobody was threatened or injured.

label: minor
en: A bag was taken from an empty bench, with no confrontation. The owner is safe and unhurt, and nobody remains at risk nearby.

label: serious

label: serious
en: After being struck with a stick, the person has a swollen arm and cannot lift it. They are awake and breathing normally; the attacker left.
tl: Namamaga ang braso at hindi maitaas matapos hampasin ng kahoy. Gising at normal huminga ang tao, at umalis na ang nanakit.

label: serious
en: A person is smashing windows with a metal bar near a closed store. Everyone is behind locked doors and nobody has been injured.

ceb: Naay tawo nga nagbuak og bintana gamit ang puthaw sa siradong tindahan. Naa sa luyo sa siradong pultahan ang tanan ug walay nasamdan.
mixed: Person smashing windows with metal bar near closed store. Everyone behind locked doors, nobody injured pero destructive activity still ongoing karon.
rationale: An ongoing destructive hazard requires urgent security response; no explicit current attack on a person is described.

label: serious
en: A crowd is fighting over belongings at the terminal. Two people have bruises and one cannot walk on a swollen ankle; no weapon is seen.

en: During the fight one adult fell and now will not wake when shouted at. Their breathing is noisy and only occasional gasps are visible.

ceb: Natumba ang hamtong sa away ug dili mamata bisan singgitan. Saba ang pagginhawa ug panagsa nga hingalo lang ang makita karon.
mixed: Adult fell during fight ug won't wake when shouted at. Noisy breathing ug occasional gasps lang, dili siya morespond karon.
rationale: Current unresponsiveness and abnormal gasping after violence indicate immediate life threat.

label: critical
en: A person was stabbed in the thigh. Blood keeps spurting despite pressure, and they are becoming drowsy while lying on the ground.
tl: Nasaksak ang tao sa hita. Tuloy ang pagbubulwak ng dugo kahit diniinan at inaantok na siya habang nakahiga sa lupa.
ceb: Gidunggab ang tawo sa paa. Padayon ang pagbuswak sa dugo bisan gipislit ug nagkaduka na siya samtang naghigda sa yuta.
mixed: Person stabbed in thigh, blood keeps spurting bisan pressure. Becoming drowsy na siya while lying sa ground ug dili mohunong ang dugo.

label: critical
en: A person is pointing a loaded gun at another person's head and threatening to fire now. The victim cannot move away.

label: needs_review
en: There are loud voices near the shop, but I cannot see whether people are arguing, celebrating, or whether anybody is hurt.

rationale: Ambiguous sound alone does not establish an active security hazard or severity.

label: needs_review
en: A forwarded message says someone was attacked yesterday. It has no current condition, injury description, or confirmation that help is still needed.

ceb: Naay gipasa nga mensahe nga adunay giatake kagahapon. Walay kasamtangang kahimtang, paghulagway sa samad, o kumpirmasyon nga kinahanglan pa og tabang karon.

label: needs_review
en: A distant person is holding something long. We cannot tell if it is a tool or weapon, and no threatening action is visible.

ceb: Naay taas nga butang nga gigunitan ang tawo sa layo. Dili matino kon himan o armas ug walay makitang hulga karon.

ceb: Natukod sa luag nga pila pero nakabalanse ang tawo ug wala natumba. Walay samad o sakit ug kalma nang nagbulag ang pundok.

label: serious
en: A fallen tree blocks the clinic access road, and a large broken limb is still hanging above it. Nobody is currently underneath or hurt.
tl: Nakaharang ang puno sa daan papuntang klinika at may malaking putol na sangang nakabitin pa sa itaas. Walang tao sa ilalim o nasaktan.
ceb: Gibabagan sa natumbang kahoy ang dalan sa klinika ug naay dakong nabali nga sanga nga nagbitay sa ibabaw. Walay tawo sa ubos o nasamdan.
mixed: Fallen tree blocks clinic access road, large broken limb still hanging above. Nobody underneath or hurt pero ongoing falling hazard ug blocked access.
rationale: Blocked essential access plus an unstable overhead limb requires urgent response without stated immediate casualty.

label: serious
en: A fallen electrical wire is sparking across an empty footpath. People are staying away, nobody has touched it, and power remains on.
tl: Kumikislap ang nahulog na kawad sa bakanteng daanan. Lumalayo ang mga tao, walang humawak nito, at hindi pa napapatay ang kuryente.
ceb: Nagkidlap ang nahulog nga kable sa bakanteng agianan. Nagpalayo ang mga tawo, walay mihikap niini, ug wala pa mapalong ang kuryente.
mixed: Fallen electrical wire sparking across empty footpath. People staying away, nobody touched it pero power remains on, active hazard pa karon.
rationale: An active energized wire is an urgent hazard even without a present casualty.

label: serious
en: A ceiling panel fell onto an adult's shoulder. They are alert and breathing normally but have swelling and cannot lift the arm.
tl: Nahulog ang panel ng kisame sa balikat ng adulto. Gising at normal huminga siya pero namamaga at hindi maitaas ang braso.
ceb: Nahulog ang panel sa kisame sa abaga sa hamtong. Mata ug normal moginhawa siya pero hubag ug dili maalsa ang bukton.
mixed: Ceiling panel fell onto adult's shoulder. Alert ug normal breathing siya pero swollen ang shoulder ug cannot lift arm, need assistance.
rationale: A function-limiting limb injury needs urgent assessment with no explicit immediate life-threatening sign.

label: serious
en: The crowd keeps pushing toward a narrow gate. Everyone is still standing and speaking, but people cannot move backward and need crowd control.
tl: Patuloy ang tulakan ng grupo patungo sa makitid na tarangkahan. Nakatayo at nakakapagsalita pa ang lahat pero hindi makaurong at kailangan ng kontrol.
ceb: Padayon ang pagtukmod sa pundok paingon sa pig-ot nga ganghaan. Nagbarog ug makasulti pa ang tanan pero dili makaatras ug kinahanglan og pagdumala.
mixed: Crowd keeps pushing toward narrow gate. Everyone standing and speaking pa, pero cannot move backward ug need urgent crowd control karon.
rationale: Ongoing unsafe crowd pressure requires urgent intervention before an explicit crushing casualty is described.

label: critical
en: A heavy tree trunk is pinning a person's chest. They are struggling for each breath and cannot free themselves from underneath it.
tl: Naiipit ang dibdib ng tao sa mabigat na puno. Hirap siya sa bawat paghinga at hindi mailabas ang sarili mula sa ilalim.
ceb: Napiit ang dughan sa tawo sa bug-at nga punoan. Naglisod siya sa matag ginhawa ug dili makagawas gikan sa ilalom niini.
mixed: Heavy tree trunk pinning person's chest. Struggling for each breath siya ug cannot free themselves, naa pa gihapon siya underneath karon.
rationale: Chest compression with current breathing difficulty is an immediate threat to life.

label: critical
en: After touching the fallen wire, the person dropped to the ground. They do not respond and their chest is not moving now.
tl: Bumagsak ang tao matapos hawakan ang nahulog na kawad. Hindi siya tumutugon at hindi gumagalaw ang kanyang dibdib sa ngayon.
ceb: Natumba ang tawo human mohikap sa nahulog nga kable. Dili siya motubag ug dili molihok ang iyang dughan karon bisan tawagon.
mixed: Person dropped after touching fallen wire. No response sa pagtawag ug chest not moving now, naa pa siya sa ground karon.
rationale: Unresponsiveness with no observed breathing following electrical exposure requires highest urgency.

label: critical
en: Most workers escaped the collapse, but one is trapped under concrete and will not respond. Only irregular gasps can be heard.
tl: Nakalabas ang karamihan sa pagguho pero may isang naipit sa kongkreto at hindi tumutugon. Putol-putol na hingal lang ang maririnig.
ceb: Nakagawas ang kadaghanan sa pagguho pero ang usa natanggong ilalom sa kongkreto ug dili motubag. Putol-putol nga hingalo ra ang madungog.
mixed: Most workers escaped collapse, pero one trapped under concrete and won't respond. Irregular gasps lang ang madungog gikan niya karon.
rationale: The trapped unresponsive casualty with gasping determines severity, not the safe majority.

label: critical
en: One person has fallen beneath the packed crowd. People are stepping on their chest, and the person cannot breathe or get up.
tl: May taong natumba sa ilalim ng siksik na grupo. Natatapakan ang dibdib niya at hindi siya makahinga o makatayo mula sa ilalim.
ceb: Naay tawo nga natumba ilalom sa dasok nga pundok. Gitamakan ang iyang dughan ug dili siya kaginhawa o makatindog gikan sa ilalom.
mixed: Person fell beneath packed crowd, people stepping on their chest. Cannot breathe or get up siya, ongoing pa ang crowd pressure karon.
rationale: Current trampling and inability to breathe are immediately life-threatening.

label: needs_review
en: A caller says a tree is down nearby. They cannot confirm its size, whether it blocks anything, or if a person was hit.
tl: May tumawag na may natumbang puno sa malapit. Hindi matiyak ang laki, kung may naharang, o kung may taong natamaan.
ceb: Naay nanawag nga adunay natumbang kahoy sa duol. Dili matino ang gidak-on, kon naay gibabagan, o kon naay tawo nga naigo.
mixed: Caller says tree down nearby. Unknown size, unsure kung naay blocked road or person hit, wala pay direct details sa scene.
rationale: Fallen tree report lacks exposure, extent, access, and casualty information.

label: needs_review
en: The short message says dead beside the generator. Nobody can confirm if it describes the machine, an animal, or a person.
tl: Patay sa tabi ng generator lang ang maikling mensahe. Walang makatiyak kung makina, hayop, o isang tao ang tinutukoy nito.
ceb: Patay sa tapad sa generator ra ang mubo nga mensahe. Walay makatino kon makina, hayop, o tawo ba ang gipasabot niini.
mixed: Message says dead beside generator, mao ra. Nobody can confirm kung machine, animal or person ang subject, unclear ang current condition.
rationale: An alarming word with an explicitly uncertain subject must not be asserted as a human casualty.

label: needs_review
en: We heard a crash inside the closed building. We cannot see damage, know whether anyone is inside, or determine if help is needed.
tl: May narinig na malakas na pagbagsak sa saradong gusali. Hindi makita ang pinsala, malaman kung may tao sa loob, o kung kailangan ng tulong.
ceb: Nakadungog og kusog nga lagapak sulod sa siradong building. Dili makita ang kadaot, mahibaloan kon naay tawo sulod, o kon kinahanglan og tabang.
mixed: Heard a crash inside closed building. Can't see damage or confirm if people inside, unknown pa kung naay injured or need rescue.
rationale: A sound alone gives no reliable current structural or human condition.

label: needs_review
en: The event message says someone cannot breathe if the crowd gets tighter. It does not confirm present symptoms, injuries, or crowd pressure.
tl: Sabi sa mensahe, baka hindi makahinga kung lalo pang magsiksikan. Hindi nakumpirma ang kasalukuyang sintomas, pinsala, o tulakan ng mga tao.
ceb: Ang mensahe nag-ingon nga basin dili kaginhawa kon modasok pa ang pundok. Walay kumpirmasyon sa kasamtangang sintomas, samad, o pagpamugos sa tawo.
mixed: Event message says someone cannot breathe if crowd gets tighter. Wala gi-confirm current symptoms, injuries or actual crowd pressure karon.
rationale: A conditional future breathing statement does not establish actual current respiratory compromise.
